question: How is Shiva established everywhere as maker?
premises: Shiva is maker as mother and father.
Emanation indeed is power; this again is as Shiva-bindu.
inference: Shiva is everywhere maker through mother-father emanation power as Shiva-bindu.
plain_english: Shiva, as mother and father, maker, is established everywhere; emanation indeed is power; this again is as Shiva-bindu.
